name: Espen
title: The Fletcher
examine: Strings every bow with the story of the tree it was. Sells arrows by the dozen and keeps the best dozen back, and will not be drawn on the difference.
lines: A bow is a tree taught a second trade.
Yannick gets the one tree in a hundred. I get the one branch in a thousand. We do not argue. We trade.
The dozen on the counter are good. The dozen under it are spoken for. No, not by you.
